propositions: Cloud probe hardcodes resolved status names to ['Resolved','Done','Cancelled'] with no config override, causing issues with non-standard workflow status names to be misclassified as PRESENT_FILTERED instead of PRESENT_RESOLVED
DC reconciler already supports configurable resolved_statuses via ReconcilerConfig and [tool.rebar.reconciler] config, but Cloud probe lacks equivalent functionality, breaking parity
Cloud probe should read jira.resolved_statuses from config (via _as_str_list coercer and REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES env override) with fallback to module-level default when unset or empty
classify_probe_response must resolve the configured resolved-status set at runtime and bind it into the jira_family classifier, mirroring DC settings.py guard behavior

Custom config jira.resolved_statuses=['Closed','Complete'] should classify 'Closed' issues as PRESENT_RESOLVED and 'Done' issues as PRESENT_FILTERED, proving configured set replaces rather than merges with default
